source: OpenAlex API /works (IDs written from the response by scripts/run_search.py)
query: slum OR slums OR "informal settlement" OR "informal settlements"
filter: title_and_abstract.search.exact:slum OR slums OR "informal settlement" OR "informal settlements",is_retracted:false,publication_year:2022-2026
oql:
get works where retracted is (false)
  and year >= (2022)
  and year <= (2026)
  and title-abstract has ("informal settlement" OR "informal settlements" OR "slum" OR "slums")
